mcqs.question: Which Union ministry issued the gazette notification for distribution of Superior Kerosene Oil through the Public Distribution System in 21 States/UTs, including Delhi and Gujarat?
options: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
mcqs.explanation: The Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas issued the gazette notification for Superior Kerosene Oil distribution through the Public Distribution System in 21 States/UTs, including Delhi and Gujarat. The Ministry of Agriculture is associated with the pesticides legislation, not this notification.

mcqs.question: With reference to CropLife India’s concerns over the draft Pesticides Management Bill, 2025, identify the incorrect statement.
options: CropLife India sought changes in the draft Pesticides Management Bill, 2025.
CropLife India highlighted an innovation gap.
CropLife India demanded 5-year Protection of Regulatory Data.
CropLife India did not seek any changes in the draft Pesticides Management Bill, 2025.
mcqs.explanation: The incorrect statement is that CropLife India did not seek changes in the draft Bill. CropLife India sought changes, citing an innovation gap and demanding 5-year Protection of Regulatory Data; the tempting error reverses its stated position.
